summary: Independence Realty Trust filed an 8-K disclosing the September 22, 2026 amendment to its September 8, 2026 merger agreement with Centerspace, electing an alternative structure whereby CSR will merge into IRT Merger Sub, with Merger Sub surviving, rather than the reverse. IRT remains the acquirer of the North Dakota REIT and its operating partnership. No revised price, exchange ratio, premium or closing date is restated in this excerpt. The amendment also waives representation inaccuracies caused solely by the structural change. Watch the Form S-4 and joint proxy timing, shareholder votes, and any revised deal terms.
